title: fix(tlon): events are lost with CRLF or multiline SSE data
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Tlon can keep an SSE connection open while silently missing events when the stream uses legal CRLF/CR line endings or multiple `data` lines.

## User Impact

Tlon delivers those events to its subscriptions and acknowledges handled events. Existing LF streams, bounded buffering, failed-handler replay, reconnect, and shutdown behavior remain in the same owner. No configuration change is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Handle the line endings and data-field joining defined by the [SSE parsing contract](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#parsing-an-event-stream). Keep a split CRLF as one newline and combine data fields instead of overwriting them. Do not alter authentication or reconnect policy.

## Evidence

- [Original-source proof](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/38289939240): 32 tests, 25 pass and seven intended delivery-assertion failures on `03512be2f3df16d4ec861ed1bebeaa967c30da2d`. All original tests and ordering are retained. Raw artifacts were inspected: no skips, unhandled exceptions, or suite errors.
- Six real loopback HTTP cases exercise public subscription/connect, LF/CRLF/CR framing, single/multiline data, cookie/path, delivered payload order, actual ACK requests, and shutdown. A later legal LF event confirms the connection is alive, so baseline failure is missing delivery rather than a timeout. Two separate byte-chunk cases cover split delimiters; existing UTF-8 and 16 MiB boundary tests remain intact.
- [Earlier candidate proof](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/38291078503) on `b01a23563a9b4ee74940138b2c079ecf24ffebad`: the same fixture bytes pass all 32 cases; the complete Tlon lane passes 287 tests across 34 files (30/2 worker-watch plus 257/32 messaging), and canonical build passes. Raw receipts were inspected. The run remains FAILURE because checker preflight lacked `rg` and a comparison base; types/lint did not run.
- The [corrected official checker job](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/38293434852/job/114958723006) passed preflight guards, production core/UI types, and 22 core test shards, then failed the unrelated UI chat fixture with TS2322 at `chat-composer-disabled-banner.test.ts:38`; extension types and lint were not reached. [Pure-original-base attribution](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/38298834382/job/114976458999) independently reproduced that exact compiler failure without this PR. Its successful diagnostic job audits compiler exit 2, not a passing typecheck. Upstream [2df22512f2fe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2df22512f2fe7f41405037cb942b6d04ec1e42f4) repairs the fixture. These earlier broad checks remain red.
- The [subsequent touched-file lint](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/38298834382/job/114976459372) identified a diff-caused parameter reassignment. Current head `956642adee25cc8517d8a7264b24a0b4e1a800b9` replaces it with an immutable local value, with unchanged fixture bytes. Fresh independent P0–P3 source review is scoped-clean.
- [Current exact-head proof](https://github.com/ly85206559/openclaw/actions/runs/38301062316) is SUCCESS. Downloaded raw artifacts bind product/tree and fixture hashes: 32/32 critical cases and the entire canonical 287/34 Tlon lane pass with zero skips, unhandled errors or suite errors. Touched-file format/lint, canonical build and the complete selected `pnpm check:changed` plan pass, including extension production/test types, all three Knip export scans (zero entries), selected guards and runtime import cycles. The build meets hard UI limits; startup CSS exceeds its advisory target only. No budget or baseline was relaxed. Earlier broad UI failure remains historical red, not relabeled as passed.
- [Upstream READY CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38300001291) on current head is SUCCESS, including the required `openclaw/ci-gate`, selected Node tests, guards, production/test types and lint. Unselected jobs are SKIPPED, not passed. Current-head bot review has no actionable findings and accepts transport proof; CI and bot review do not replace maintainer acceptance.
- This is real HTTP transport-boundary proof, not a live Urbit ship or full Gateway/agent conversation claim.


### Additional verification

Verified commit `956642adee25cc8517d8a7264b24a0b4e1a800b9` without adding commits or replacing the contributor’s work.

- An isolated built Gateway with Tlon configured against a loopback Urbit HTTP fixture reproduced the defect on main `377f4a23ed94fe5966d4cfbfd55d1e2d4a100927`: only the LF single-line control reached the recording model provider. LF multiline and CRLF/CR events were lost while the one SSE connection stayed open.
- On this head, all six LF/CRLF/CR × single/multiline inputs reached the recording provider exactly once, in order, on one continuously open connection. The fixture also served login, scry, subscription, poke, and acknowledgement requests.
- The two focused SSE suites passed all 32 tests; changed-file formatting and lint passed.
- A separate isolated CLI agent turn using the real `gpt-5-mini` provider returned the requested marker.
- No overlap with Pash/Sarah changes.

User-visible result: Tlon receives legal SSE events instead of silently losing them. Credit remains with @ly85206559 for the reproduction and fix.

Merge risk: two-way door; reverting restores the old parser, with no config or stored-state migration. Blast radius is limited to Tlon SSE input parsing.
